# Afro Beauty & Braids

> Braiding studio & beauty supply based in Pflugerville, Texas. A family-run braiding studio, a full beauty supply and handmade Senegalese apparel in one Pflugerville storefront. Friendly faces, everything for your hair, and prices regulars say beat Amazon.

- Phone: (512) 822-5849
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Austin, Round Rock, Hutto, Manor, Wells Branch
- Google rating: 4.1 from 147 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/afro-beauty-and-braids/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/afro-beauty-and-braids/book.html

## Services
- Braiding studio: Braiders in-house for knotless, box braids, twists, cornrows and faux locs. Walk-ins taken when the chairs are not booked.
- Braiding hair & wigs: Walls of pre-stretched braiding hair, faux locs and a full wig wall, in every shade you are after.
- Natural hair & skin care: The products you actually use, from castor oil and shea butter to edge control and gels.
- Tools & accessories: Rollers, perm rods, combs, gloves, bonnets and every little thing for wash day and install day.
- African apparel: Beautifully handmade Senegalese apparel, dashikis and dresses in bold prints, for everyday or the big day.
- Jewelry & men's grooming: Beaded and cowrie bracelets, earrings, plus beard oils and grooming for the men.

## About
Afro Beauty & Braids opened in February 2016 in the strip center at 616 FM 685 in Pflugerville. It is Black-owned, family owned and operated, and regulars say they are greeted with a smile and a real conversation every time. Inside it is three shops in one: a braiding studio with gold-framed mirrors and wood stations, a full-size beauty supply with walls of braiding hair, wigs and hair care, and racks of handmade Senegalese apparel, dashikis, earrings and bracelets. Look for the red awning and the African Braiding Salon banner. Customers come for one thing and leave with everything on their list.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 8:30 AM to 8 PM and Sunday 9 AM to 6 PM. Holiday hours can change, so call (512) 822-5849 if you are not sure.
- Q: What braid styles do you do?
  A: Knotless and box braids, cornrows and feed-ins, stitch braids, Senegalese and passion twists, boho braids and faux locs, plus kids' braids. Bring a photo of the look you want and call (512) 822-5849 to check timing.
- Q: Do you take braiding walk-ins?
  A: Yes, when the braiders are not booked. Call (512) 822-5849 before you head over to check the wait, or book ahead to lock in your time.
- Q: Can I buy my braiding hair here?
  A: Yes. The shop carries pre-stretched braiding hair, faux locs and crochet hair from brands like X-Pression, Lulutress and Afri, so you can pick up your hair on the way to the chair.
- Q: Do you carry men's products?
  A: Yes. There are beard oils, molding putty and hair care for men alongside everything for women.
- Q: Do you sell African clothing?
  A: Yes. Handmade Senegalese apparel, dashikis and dresses, plus beaded and cowrie bracelets and earrings. Men's beard oils and grooming are on the shelves too.
